description.value: London Farm is a heritage history museum dating to 1880, operated by the City of Richmond on Dyke Road along the Richmond dyke trail network. The site offers a glimpse into early agricultural and settler life in the Fraser delta region. As a free-admission, government-operated attraction situated directly on a popular cycling route, it represents a culturally significant stop for touring cyclists exploring the Richmond waterfront.
